text:
Yes — I added note file attachments.

What changed:
- Users can now upload a file to a note.
- Notes now store attachment metadata in SQLite.
- Files are saved on the server and can be downloaded again later from the note.
- The note editor now shows attached files and a download action.
- Frontend API/types were updated to support attachments.

A couple of notes:
- This currently supports uploading and downloading from a note, but I didn’t add file preview or drag-and-drop.
- Existing notes will still work; attachments are optional.

If you want, I can also add:
- drag-and-drop upload
- inline attachment list in the note card
- delete attachment support
- file type/size restrictions per note
